key_insight: PaddleMaterials unifies six materials-learning task classes in one toolkit while preserving task-specific representations and physical semantics.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can compose verifiable materials workflows and enable compiled execution through one setting without changing model definitions.
method: Unify data processing, training, evaluation, pretrained models and workflows across six task classes.
Record physical quantities, units, aggregation conventions and references in task interfaces.
Use graph optimization, operator fusion and hardware-targeted code generation for compiled execution.
evidence_signal: Across 65 model instances in 11 groups, compilation accelerated every instance in eight groups; LiMnO2 formation-energy predictions differed from same-geometry PBE+U references by at most 7 meV/atom, with model-step costs below one-twentieth of a DFT single-point calculation.
watch_item: The reported case studies do not establish accuracy across broader chemistries, and compilation did not accelerate every model in all groups.
paper_title: PaddleMaterials: An End-to-End Deep Learning Toolkit for Materials Science
